record.question: Who has been recently appointed as the Governor of Assam?
record.explanation: Answer C: J. B. Patnaik. J. B. Patnaik was appointed Governor of Assam by the President's 21 November 2009 announcement. That recent appointment is the one relevant to the March 2010 paper. Historical/source note: Recent relative to the March 2010 examination. Reference: https://presidentofindia.nic.in/smt-pratibha-devisingh-patil/press_releases/president-appoints-governors. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
